bifrost: none for Matter or Thread; nearby: springboard/src/net/wifi.rs and springboard/src/net/wifi_config.rs (Wi-Fi credentials), springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs (BlueZ mgmt pairing), springboard/src/net/share.rs (LAN beacon)
summary: Apple's Matter framework is a controller API for Matter smart-home accessories: commissioning, cluster reads and writes, and subscriptions. BifrOSt now decodes Matter setup codes (the QR payload and the manual pairing code) and parses commissionable and operational DNS-SD names and TXT records, all in springboard/core/src/matter.rs. It still has no controller, fabric or certificate store, no Thread, no cluster client and no SDK API, so the framework stays partial.

features.feature: Onboarding a Matter device (setup code, QR payload parsing)
features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/matter.rs (parse_qr, base38_decode, parse_manual_code, passcode_is_valid); springboard/core/src/matter.rs (setup payloads)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. Setup payload decoding is in core: the QR code (MT: and Base38, 88-bit payload) and the 11 and 21 digit manual pairing code with its Verhoeff check digit. Nothing feeds it from a camera or a BLE scan yet, so the onboarding flow does not start. round 75, host only: setup payload parsing.

features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/matter_fabric.rs (Fabric, compressed_fabric_id, Controller::initialize, Controller::allocate_node_id, Controller::encode, Controller::decode)
features.note: Fabric identifier and root key checks, the compressed fabric identifier (HKDF-SHA256, not yet checked against a published vector), node identifier allocation and the credential record's text form are tested headless in core/tests/parity_sdk-rest-09.rs. Gap: no key pair generation, no operational certificate signing and no service writes the record to disk; those need elliptic-curve code and the lab machine.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/net/wifi.rs, springboard/src/net/wifi_config.rs (Wi-Fi only); springboard/src/net/thread_dataset.rs (Thread operational dataset); tests: springboard/tests/parity_sdk-complete-27.rs
features.note: Wi-Fi join, saved network configuration and the Thread operational dataset (hex and TLV parsing, record checks, attach checklist) are tested headless in tests/parity_sdk-complete-27.rs. Gap: there is no Thread border router, no network on the radio and no device attestation; those need hardware and a commissioner service.

features.apple: Commissioned accessories are found over the local network by the controller (framework-internal)
features.bifrost: springboard/core/src/matter.rs (service_kind, commissionable_from_txt, operational_from_instance); the transport is still springboard/src/net/share.rs; springboard/core/src/matter.rs (commissionable and operational discovery)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 12 tests. Parses the _matterc._udp and _matter._tcp instance names and the commissionable TXT keys (D, VP, CM, DN, PH). There is no mDNS responder or querier, and apps cannot browse services. round 75, host only: discovery model, no live mDNS listener.

gaps: No Matter controller: no fabric, certificates, commissioning or interaction model, in the shell or the SDK.
No Thread support: no border router, no Thread network credentials and no OpenThread stack.

No mDNS or DNS-SD transport: the name and TXT parsers in springboard/core/src/matter.rs have no multicast responder or querier, and apps cannot browse services. The only LAN beacon is springboard/src/net/share.rs.
No BLE commissioning path, and no camera or scan source for setup codes. The Bluetooth module handles classic pairing only (springboard/src/bare/bluetooth.rs).
No SDK API or app-facing surface for smart-home accessories, and no Home-style app. Whether BifrOSt should add one is a product decision, not a technical gap.
